faq.question: Q1. What are the posts available in NHM Mizoram Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: NHM Mizoram is recruiting for Medical Officer, Staff Nurse, and Data Analyst positions. These roles are essential for strengthening healthcare services in Mizoram.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are announced by NHM Mizoram?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies announced for the Medical Officer, Staff Nurse, and Data Analyst posts. This includes one Medical Officer, one Staff Nurse, and three Data Analyst positions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for NHM Mizoram Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for candidates to submit their offline applications for the NHM Mizoram recruitment is 10 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for these NHM Mizoram posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the NHM Mizoram Medical Officer, Staff Nurse, and Data Analyst posts is offline. Candidates need to send their completed application forms to the specified address.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary range for the recruited positions at NHM Mizoram?
faq.answer: The salary for these contractual positions ranges from Rs. 15,000 to Rs. 50,000 per month, depending on the specific post. Medical Officers receive Rs. 50,000, Staff Nurses Rs. 22,000, and Data Analysts Rs. 15,000.

faq.question: Q6. What are the required qualifications for these NHM Mizoram vacancies?
faq.answer: For Medical Officer, an MBBS degree is required. For Staff Nurse, a B.Sc (Nursing) is needed. For Data Analyst, a Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) is the essential qualification.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for NHM Mizoram Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the NHM Mizoram recruitment. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the NHM Mizoram posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the NHM Mizoram recruitment includes a Written Examination followed by a Personal Interview. Candidates must perform well in both stages to be considered for selection.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the selected candidates be posted?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will be posted in Mizoram, specifically in locations like Aizawl (for Medical Officer and Staff Nurse at Mission Veng UHWCs) and districts like Jahthial, Lawngtlai & Siaha (for Data Analyst).

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of NHM Mizoram for more details?
faq.answer: For more detailed information regarding the recruitment, candidates can visit the official website of National Health Mission Mizoram at https://nhmmizoram.org. All official updates and notifications will be available there.
